response.justification: Bogdan brings deep, broad hands-on engineering experience (16+ years across web, backend, embedded, mobile), genuine open-source credibility, Linux/DevOps exposure, and a CS degree — all of which align well with the technical side of the role. However, two core requirements are not met: German at C1 minimum (resume states 'Basic') is essential for a client-advisory leadership role in a German consultancy, and there is no evidence of formal team leadership, people management, or technical project management ownership — his titles are consistently individual-contributor (Senior/Staff Engineer), with the exception of a self-founded open-source project. Architecture/UML/requirements-management and IT security/compliance experience are also not demonstrated, and Python is absent from the skill list. Strong senior engineer, but not a fit for a Head of Development profile as specified.
strengths: Very broad, long-tenured hands-on engineering across many stacks and domains
Authentic open-source track record (GISCollective, D-lang libraries, conference talks, workshops)
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring instincts via courses, dojos, and full-day workshops
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — hard blocker for client advisory
No formal leadership, line management, or technical project management experience
No demonstrated architecture/UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work
